static_rules.description: the pool config's keyword and length rules, mapped on train+calib

learned_min_cost.description: learned min_cost at floor 0.3, no exploration

labels: no latency is measured or simulated in this experiment
costs are the recorded costs of each model on each item
the true value of a target policy is its own deterministic full-information replay on the same test items the estimators see (success rate and mean recorded cost)
each interval is a 95% percentile bootstrap with 500 bootstrap resamples of the items, seeded by the logging seed; the SNIPS interval resamples the weighted ratio

the logging seed changes only the exploration draws: the test items are fixed, so the spread across seeds is exploration noise while each interval also resamples the items and is wider than that spread; coverage is measured against the in-sample true value
the learned target is min_cost at floor 0.3; a floor of 0.8 relaxes nearly every flagship decision to quality

support coverage is the share of items where the target's action had positive logging propensity; epsilon exploration covers only the safe set and a decision that relaxed a constraint does not explore, so IPS cannot estimate an action outside it
DR uses one outcome model, the logging policy's own predictions, so its bias includes that model's calibration error
